misconception_pool.misconception: Economic freedom permits a business to disregard public safety and breach signed supply contracts.
misconception_pool.fact: Economic freedom requires operating within commercial law while avoiding harmful fraud or contract breaches.

misconception_pool.misconception: Free enterprise means businesses can operate with zero government laws, safety rules, or contract enforcement.
misconception_pool.fact: Economic freedom requires legal boundaries that enforce contracts, protect property rights, and prevent fraud or harm to others.

misconception_pool.misconception: Economic freedom and license mean the exact same thing whenever a private business owner sets company policy.
misconception_pool.fact: Freedom is the right to act within moral and legal rules, whereas license is the abuse of freedom that disregards harm to others.

misconception_pool.misconception: Eli Whitney's only major contribution to American industry was inventing the cotton gin for southern agriculture.
misconception_pool.fact: Whitney also championed interchangeable musket parts, which laid the foundation for modern mass production in northern factories.

misconception_pool.misconception: Henry Ford invented the first gasoline-powered automobile and the first moving assembly line from scratch.
misconception_pool.fact: Ford did not invent the automobile, but he perfected high-volume moving assembly line production to make cars affordable for workers.
